Rent and Eviction : Eviction of tenant-Part of tenanted premises in possession of tenant's brother-Ejectment of tenant's brother-Tenant's appeal dismissed by Supreme Court-Tenant filing an undertaking to hand over the premises to landlord on or before specified date-Later tenant intimating except the portion in possession D of his brother-Landlord filing contempt petition before Supreme Court against tenant and his brother-Tenant's brother contending that he not being a party in the case, Wai not liable to contempt-Held, contempt proceedings against tenant's brother
Decision Date : 24-01-2003 | Case No : CONTEMPT PETITION (CIVIL) No. 280/2000 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 3 Judges
